blocksHtml:
• Description

The TFN V20C Three-in-One Fiber Optic Tester is a versatile fiber optic testing tool designed for fiber installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and network inspection. It combines an Optical Power Meter (OPM), Visual Fault Locator (VFL), and LED flashlight in a compact handheld device, making it suitable for technicians working with FTTH, FTTx, telecom, and fiber communication networks.


The built-in OPM supports an optical power measurement range of -50 to +26 dBm, allowing accurate testing of optical signal power across a wide range of fiber networks. The 20mW Visual Fault Locator can detect fiber breaks, bends, poor connections, and other faults over distances of up to 20KM, depending on fiber conditions.


Key Features


  • Three-in-one fiber optic testing device
  • Built-in Optical Power Meter (OPM)
  • OPM measurement range: -50 to +26 dBm
  • Built-in 20mW Visual Fault Locator (VFL)
  • VFL detection distance: Up to 20KM
  • Integrated LED flashlight for low-light working conditions
  • Suitable for FTTH, FTTx and telecom fiber networks
  • Helps identify fiber breaks, bends and connection faults
  • Portable handheld design for field technicians
  • Suitable for fiber installation, maintenance and troubleshooting
